stimuli.stimulus_text: Most people believe tomatoes are vegetables, since you find them in salads. But tomatoes are not vegetables. After all, although tomatoes are typically savory, they have seeds, and so tomatoes are fruit.

clauses.text: Most people believe tomatoes are vegetables

tip_on_mismatch.concession: Not a concession. 'Most people believe' is the opposing-view tell. Someone else holds this position.
tip_on_mismatch.authors-conclusion: Not the author's view. 'Most people believe' flags an opposing-view, the author will push back.

clauses.text: since you find them in salads

tip_on_mismatch.authors-evidence: This evidence belongs to the opposing view. 'Since' is FABS support, but it supports the opposing-conclusion above it.

clauses.text: But tomatoes are not vegetables

tip_on_mismatch.opposing-conclusion: Not opposing. The pivot 'But' tells you we just crossed to the author. This is the author's main claim.

clauses.text: although tomatoes are typically savory

tip_on_mismatch.opposing-evidence: This is a concession not opposing evidence. Notice 'although' at the front. Concessions are the author admitting something, not someone else asserting it.

clauses.text: they have seeds
and so tomatoes are fruit

tip_on_mismatch.authors-conclusion: Intermediate not main. 'Tomatoes are fruit' supports 'tomatoes are not vegetables' and is itself supported by 'they have seeds.' Both supported and supporting.
